title: Judicial Fellowship Programme
level: Recent law graduates nominated by their universities
about: The International Court of Justice's Judicial Fellowship Programme for 2027-2028 accepts candidates nominated by universities worldwide; the Court does not accept individual applications. Nominations are due 5 February 2027.
requirements: Candidates must be nominated, and their application submitted, by their university; the Court does not accept applications from individuals
Candidates should be no more than 31 years of age at the start of the Programme, with possible exceptions in special circumstances
From the 2027-2028 edition, sponsoring universities must provide each selected candidate with a monthly stipend, health insurance and travel costs
